basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old guy living in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Just started exploring Reddit a few months back to connect with like-minded people and discover new interests. I'm currently in between jobs, taking some time to figure out my next steps, maybe in tech or something hands-on. I enjoy gaming, especially CS:GO, which led me to FACEITcom. I'm also venturing into herbal medicine, trying to find natural ways to improve my well-being. Most of my Reddit activity happens during the late evening when I'm unwinding from the day. I'm currently single and open to new experiences, both online and offline.
